    • getChildren

      public CompletableFuture<? extends List<? extends RepositoryEntity>> getChildren(long ownerId, long groupId)
      Description copied from interface: RepositoryEntity
      Returns the list of children of this element belonging to the provided experimenter and group.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Parameters:
      ownerId - the ID of the experimenter that should own the entities to retrieve
      groupId - the ID of the group that should own the entities to retrieve
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture (that may complete exceptionally) with the list of children of this entity

    • getUnsupportedReasons

      public Set<Image.UnsupportedReason> getUnsupportedReasons(PixelApi pixelApi)
      Indicate the reasons why this image is potentially unsupported by the provided pixel API.
      Parameters:
      pixelApi - the pixel API that could potentially open this image. Can be null, in which case Image.UnsupportedReason.PIXEL_API_UNAVAILABLE is returned
      Returns:
      a set of reasons of why this image is unsupported by the provided pixel API (which is empty if this image is actually supported)
